summary: Anthropic introduced Agent Skills, a feature that lets Claude load packaged instructions, scripts and resources on demand across Claude apps, Claude Code and the API, including a code execution capability and partner integrations.

mechanisms.reason: Skills let Claude autonomously select and execute code-backed capabilities and are explicitly framed by a partner as extending agentic workflows rather than manual software use.
mechanisms.quote: This unlocks new ways to bring Canva deeper into agentic workflows—helping teams capture their unique context and create stunning, high-quality designs effortlessly.
